cohort: 100 women experiencing blood loss and major PPH incidents during vaginal (n=50) and cesarean (n=50) deliveries were included.
finding: The preventive use of carbetocin significantly decreased overall blood loss.
mod_finding: Carbetocin prophylaxis significantly decreased blood loss during caesarean sections (p=0.0001) but showed no significant reduction during vaginal deliveries (p=0.0873).
